title: Sprint 1: Saturn Beacon with Ephemeral Credentials
description:
Implement Adam's beacon requirements: DeepInfra scoped JWT with mDNS announcement, key rotation, and client discovery. This is Layer 1 of the three-layer architecture - the foundation for the robot factory vision.

Sprint Goals:
- Prove network-based ephemeral access works
- Demonstrate zero-config credential discovery
- Show automatic key rotation and expiration
- Foundation for future layers (metering, budgeting, coordination)

Deliverables:
- beacons/deepinfra_beacon.py - Beacon server
- clients/beacon_test_client.py - Test client
- Documentation and demo materials
- All 8 success criteria validated

description:
Create beacons/ directory structure and verify all required dependencies are available.

Tasks:
- Create beacons/ directory in project root
- Verify dependencies available: requests, python-zeroconf, fastapi, uvicorn
- Add DEEPINFRA_API_KEY entry to .env.example (or create if needed)
- Document any missing dependencies

Success Criteria:
- beacons/ directory exists
- All dependencies confirmed available
- .env.example documents DEEPINFRA_API_KEY requirement

title: End-to-end integration testing
description:
Test complete beacon flow from startup through key rotation to expiration.

Test Scenarios:
1. Beacon Startup Flow:
   - Start beacon server
   - Verify mDNS announcement (dns-sd -B)
   - Verify TXT records contain ephemeral_key (dns-sd -L)
   
2. Client Discovery Flow:
   - Start test client
   - Verify discovery within 5 seconds
   - Verify key extraction
   - Verify successful API call to DeepInfra
   
3. Key Rotation (5 minute wait):
   - Observe beacon log rotation event
   - Observe client log update event
   - Save old key for comparison
   - Verify new key works
   
4. Key Expiration (10 minute wait):
   - Test old saved key (should be rejected by DeepInfra)
   - Test current key (should work)

Document all test results with timestamps and outcomes.

Success Criteria:
- All 8 success criteria from implementation plan verified
- Complete flow documented with evidence (logs, screenshots)
- No manual intervention needed after startup
notes: Testing framework provided via test_beacon_flow.py and beacon_test_client.py

title: Edge case testing and error handling
description:
Test edge cases and error conditions to ensure robust behavior.

Test Cases:
1. JWT >250 chars:
   - If token exceeds TXT record safe limit, document behavior
   - Test if truncation occurs
   - Document fallback strategy if needed
   
2. DeepInfra API rate limits:
   - Simulate rate limiting (429 errors)
   - Verify rotation thread handles gracefully
   - Verify exponential backoff or retry logic
   
3. Network failures during rotation:
   - Disconnect network mid-rotation
   - Verify beacon handles exception
   - Verify rotation retries when network returns
   
4. Multiple clients sharing same key:
   - Start 2+ clients discovering same beacon
   - Verify all get same ephemeral key
   - Verify all can make API calls
   
5. Client arrival mid-cycle:
   - Start beacon, wait 2 minutes
   - Start new client
   - Verify client gets current key (valid for 3+ more minutes)
   
6. Beacon crash recovery:
   - Kill beacon process
   - Verify clients detect removal
   - Restart beacon
   - Verify clients rediscover

Document all findings and mitigation strategies.

Success Criteria:
- All edge cases tested and documented
- Error handling verified
- Mitigation strategies identified
notes: Error handling implemented in rotation_loop.py, edge cases handled in code

title: Implement JWTManager class for ephemeral credential generation
description:
Create JWTManager class with thread-safe token storage and rotation detection.

Implementation:
- Create JWTManager class with threading.Lock for thread safety
- Implement generate_token() calling DeepInfra scoped JWT API
  - Headers: Authorization with DEEPINFRA_API_KEY
  - Payload: api_key_name='auto', expires_delta=600 (10 min)
  - Omit 'models' field (allows all models per Adam's requirement)
- Implement get_current_token() with lock
- Implement needs_rotation() checking if rotation interval (5 min) reached
- Store current_token and expires_at timestamp

Success Criteria:
- JWTManager generates valid tokens
- Thread-safe token access
- Rotation detection logic works (5 min interval with 10 min expiration buffer)
- Unit testable

title: Implement BeaconAnnouncer class with zeroconf mDNS registration
description:
Create BeaconAnnouncer class using python-zeroconf library for mDNS service registration with ephemeral key in TXT records.

Implementation:
- Create BeaconAnnouncer class using zeroconf library
- Implement register() method:
  - Create ServiceInfo for _saturn._tcp.local.
  - TXT records: version, api='DeepInfra', priority, ephemeral_key, rotation_interval, features
  - Add character count warning if ephemeral_key >240 chars
  - Call zeroconf.register_service()
- Implement unregister() for cleanup
  - Unregister service and close zeroconf instance
- Support re-registration (for key rotation): unregister then register

Success Criteria:
- Beacon appears in 'dns-sd -B _saturn._tcp local'
- TXT records visible in 'dns-sd -L <service> _saturn._tcp local'
- ephemeral_key present in TXT records
- Warning logged if key exceeds safe length

title: Implement key rotation background thread
description:
Create rotation_loop() function that runs in daemon thread to automatically rotate keys every 5 minutes.

Implementation:
- Create rotation_loop(jwt_manager, beacon_announcer) function
- Run in daemon thread (doesn't block shutdown)
- Check every 60 seconds if jwt_manager.needs_rotation()
- On rotation:
  1. Log rotation start
  2. jwt_manager.generate_token()
  3. beacon_announcer.register() (re-registers with new key)
  4. Log rotation complete
- Add exception handling:
  - Catch network failures gracefully
  - Catch DeepInfra API rate limits (429 errors)
  - Log errors but continue running

Success Criteria:
- Background thread starts successfully
- Observable key rotation every 5 minutes
- Old key replaced with new key in mDNS announcement
- Graceful error handling (network failures don't crash thread)

title: Implement BeaconListener class for service discovery
description:
Create BeaconListener(ServiceListener) class for discovering beacons and extracting ephemeral keys from TXT records.

Implementation:
- Create BeaconListener class extending ServiceListener
- Thread-safe beacon storage (dict with lock)
- Implement add_service(zc, type_, name):
  - Get service info
  - Extract ephemeral_key from TXT records
  - Extract priority, rotation_interval, url
  - Store in beacons dict
  - Log discovery with key preview (first 60 chars)
- Implement update_service(zc, type_, name):
  - Log update event
  - Call add_service to re-extract new key
- Implement remove_service(zc, type_, name):
  - Remove from beacons dict
  - Log removal
- Implement get_best_beacon():
  - Return lowest priority beacon
  - Return None if no beacons available

Success Criteria:
- Listener detects beacon within 5 seconds
- Extracts ephemeral_key correctly from TXT records
- Thread-safe beacon access
- Priority-based selection works
